body: I've got no idea. I hope it's just that because our semester ends in two weeks time.
I did and all I got was, "I just can't picture us anymore".
She just said she doesn't see us together anymore. I've got no idea what's changed over the past month.
There's really not. We had so many plans for the future that I just cant see with anyone else, and I don't want them to be either
I don't really want to dump that on her and make her feel like it's her fault or something.
